source_authority.dataset: Bontrager et al. range-wide local adaptation source

record_level_qualification: Nonmissing study, taxon, source, site, fitness_type, original source lat/lon, original destination lat/lon; finite WGS84 plausible; exact source/name and garden coordinates, no imputation.
taxon_rule: Require original binomial (genus+species) for species-level macro counts; report ambiguous labels separately without fuzzy correction.
source_ambiguity: A unique (study,taxon,source) ID should map to exactly one source coordinate pair, and (study,taxon,site) to exactly one garden coordinate pair; conflicted IDs excluded and diagnosed, not repaired by fitness.
unique_experiment_cell: study × taxon × site × fitness_type. Cell has >=2 distinct original source IDs AND >=2 distinct source coordinate tuples; within same study taxon site to hold shared experiment conditions.
independence: A cell is not an independent study or species; shared source populations, sites and papers must not be treated as independent replicates.
geographic_predictor_qualification: Current and 21ka climates must be measured at original source coordinates and within-cell climate matching evaluated response-blind in a separate frozen stage; site geolocation alone is not sufficient.

future_macro_gate.precommitted_grouping: Study–species connected graph; component disjoint roles without looking at fitness

source_overlap: Overlap with Hargreaves et al. and Hereford primary studies UNKNOWN until source-paper IDs reconciled; count not additive.
selection_bias: Dataset was assembled to investigate local adaptation across species ranges; do not describe as an unselected global sample.
report_only: Aggregate counts by exclusion, distinct study/taxon/species/genus/cells with >=2 sources, shared experiment blocks, source category frequencies and SHA; no original point coordinates/IDs or fitness values exported.
expected_result_interpretation: Source-only geography qualification, not demonstration of local adaptation, plasticity or speciation.
